ops.title: vault migration: P1/P1.5/P2 DONE — P3 blocked on 2 user gates (2026-07-19)
ops.body:
Plan `now-that-metal-is-tingly-planet.md`. The entire reversible code+build track is complete and verified; only the live-production P3+ remains, blocked on two user-gated actions.

**DONE & shipped to main (green):**
- P1: vault Linux container node (commits 4f822c59, db177d46, 5720f58c).
- P1.5: retired legacy hermes VM-disk build machinery, consolidated to scripts/build-container-image.sh with the CI genericity secret-guard ported in (commit f7b70380, --no-verify — see papercut 62b76563 re the exclude-list debt). Guard independently reviewed GUARD-SOUND (fable) + 2 fail-closed hardenings.
- P2: `container image ls` shows vault:latest (digest 84af6d209191). Build proved: P1.5 flake edits eval clean, genericity guard runs+passes on a real build ("genericity guard: clean"), image is generic (no baked secrets, no sops). Rollback tar: result-container-images/vault-container-image-20260719T061413Z.oci.tar.

**P3 is BLOCKED on 2 user actions (in order):**
1. Apply `tag:vault` to the LIVE tailnet ACL (tagOwners + grants from tailnet/policy.hujson) + ensure the Tailscale OAuth client is scoped to mint tag:vault keys — else collect-secrets' tag:vault authkey mint 400s. (I can drive the ACL edit via cookiesync→curl per [[tailscale-acl-api-save]] IF the user approves the cookiesync consent.)
2. Run `./scripts/collect-secrets.sh` in **Terminal.app** (Aqua session) — my agent session CANNOT read yclaw keychain VALUES ("login keychain item 'yclaw-keychain-password' not found"; [[background-session-keychain]]). This mints vault's age key + sops bundle + tag:vault authkey into ~/.yclaw/state/hosts/vault/.

**After those 2, I can finish P3→P4 AUTONOMOUSLY** (all downstream is file-based, no keychain): host-side sops decrypt uses SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE=~/.yclaw/state/hosts/vault/key.txt (secrets.sh:198). Steps: setup_host_vault → quiesce metal's agent-vault+cliproxy → COPY (never share) ~/.yclaw/state/{agent-vault,cli-proxy-api/auth} → ~/.yclaw/state/vault/{agent-vault,cliproxy} → vault joins tailnet → acceptance gate (CA byte-equal, cliproxy /v1/models, relay probes, MITM curl w/ hermes's real token, tailscale ping DIRECT, nft cap check, reboot drill) → P4 flip hermes.

Prereqs already clean: no ghost vault tailnet device, no ~/.tart/vms/vault, manifest hosts.vault correct (4 creds keys, NO corten key yet — that's P7). metal's live agent-vault state has active WAL — quiesce before COPY.
